speaker: Doctor
text: Welcome to the clinic. I am Dr. Agent; you are here because a newborn is presenting with respiratory distress. Can you tell me exactly when these symptoms started and if the baby was born prematurely?

speaker: Patient
text: Newborn, born at 33 weeks of gestation. The newborn is presenting with respiratory distress 2 hours after birth. The mother had an uneventful pregnancy until premature onset of labor. There was no significant prenatal care history mentioned.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Respiratory Distress Syndrome (RDS) secondary to prematurity.

The baby was born at 33 weeks and is in respiratory distress within two hours of birth. I need to confirm the Apgar scores and check the results of an arterial blood gas analysis. REQUEST TEST: Arterial_Blood_Gas. REQUEST IMAGES: Chest_X-Ray.
